snippet.title: Desktop Explorer Trailer - 2025 Convergence Showcase
snippet.description:
In Recurring Dream's Desktop Explorer, you rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them? This trailer debuted in the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase, and includes a hidden puzzle.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527160
